policy: Preserve safe failures, correct generalized causes, never rewrite a blocked receipt, and always create a fresh run ID after a change.

events.cause: The model paraphrased one immutable acceptance criterion.
events.correction: Bind ordered Quest criteria verbatim on the trusted host.

events.cause: One generated troll source had no isolated central character after approved segmentation.
events.correction: Regenerate only the rejected sprite slot once with deterministic feedback; do not weaken normalization or regenerate accepted slots.

events.cause: A nonspatial resurrection ability used a radius below the shared spatial schema minimum.
events.correction: Canonicalize only nonspatial resurrection radius to the trusted minimum; keep invalid damage and heal radii rejected.

events.cause: All 44 deterministic checks passed, but the Verifier returned the wrong number of criterion findings for Q1.
events.correction: Request one bounded schema-format retry with the exact ordered criteria; a second mismatch still blocks.

events.cause: A copied brief carried a stale ToolPack manifest binding.
events.correction: The trusted registry rejected it before planning; create a fresh brief bound to the current approved manifest.

events.cause: An operator command supplied an empty run ID after a local import error.
events.correction: Worker SAFE_RUN_ID validation rejected it before reading or mutating any run; validate the ID locally before dispatch.
